name: @avatark/encounter-realization-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral contracts for Sprint 14's encounter-realization domain: EncounterRecord (the realized-encounter historical truth, distinct from Sprint 10's own EncounterOpportunity/Sprint 11's own EncounterHistoryEntry, which stay unchanged), its lifecycle status, and a closed EncounterConsequence union. No implementations, no renderer objects, zero psychology, zero franchise content.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
